capability: Order withdrawal requests: the buyer's request, through the store, to withdraw from an order, which the merchant reviews (WooCommerce Order withdrawal, order_withdrawal, /my-account/withdraw-order/, Order withdrawal request)
note: Only WooCommerce shows it so far: a form in the buyer's account (/my-account/withdraw-order/, WC-S-5438), a feature that turns it on (order_withdrawal, WC-S-5440), and a customer and a staff email (WC-S-0314, WC-S-0315). Not CM-RET-003: no statement held says a withdrawal returns an order's items or refunds it, and WooCommerce 'does not determine whether the customer has a legal right to withdraw' (WC-S-5441). Parent CM-ORD-001, a reading: WooCommerce names it for the order (Order withdrawal), and a request that matches an order adds an order note (WC-S-5443); no statement puts it under returns and refunds. The reviewer may join it to CM-RET-003 on role, as the buyer's request to undo a purchase, or put it under CM-RET-001. Homonyms: B's CM-INV-009 (Zid's inventory withdrawal priority) and WooPayments' dispute amounts 'withdrawn from your account' (WC-S-5320) are other things. Shopify's help section EU right of withdrawal compliance (SH-I-2129, SH-C-175, domain A naming C) is left to the back-fill.
